"""Emulate the controller: 64 lines, one at a time, awaiting each response."""
import json
import subprocess
import sys
import time
sys.path.insert(0, "/app/work")

reqs = []
import gen, gen2, gen3, maxcase, gen_struct, random
rng = random.Random(4242)
for i in range(24):
    reqs.append(gen.gen_instance(rng, i, big=(i % 6 == 5)))
for i in range(14):
    reqs.append(gen2.gen(rng, ["feas", "tight", "big"][i % 3]))
for i in range(16):
    reqs.append(gen3.gen_feasible(rng, big=(i % 5 == 4), tight=(i % 3 == 0)))
for i in range(10):
    reqs.append(maxcase.build(rng, ["plain", "infeas_budget", "tight", "infeas_mlu", "infeas_fail"][i % 5]))
payloads = []
for r in reqs:
    payloads.append(json.dumps(r, separators=(",", ":")))
payloads.insert(30, "not json")
payloads.insert(31, "{\"epoch\":1}")
payloads.insert(58, "   ")
payloads = payloads[:64]
print("total lines:", len(payloads))

p = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "/app/submission/planner.py"],
                     stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                     stderr=subprocess.PIPE, bufsize=0)
responses = []
worst = 0.0
start = time.time()
t_start = start
for i, line in enumerate(payloads):
    p.stdin.write((line + "\n").encode())
    p.stdin.flush()
    t0 = time.time()
    out = p.stdout.readline()
    dt = time.time() - t0
    worst = max(worst, dt)
    responses.append(json.loads(out))
    if not out:
        print("no response at line", i)
        break
p.stdin.close()
rc = p.wait()
print("exit=%d total=%.1fs worst-response=%.2fs cpu-ish=%s" % (rc, time.time() - t_start, worst, "?"))
err = p.stderr.read().decode()
if err:
    print("stderr:", err[:800])
open("/app/work/_req_i.jsonl", "w").write("\n".join(payloads) + "\n")
open("/app/work/_res_i.jsonl", "w").write("\n".join(json.dumps(r) for r in responses) + "\n")
import fullcheck
bad = fullcheck.run("/app/work/_req_i.jsonl", "/app/work/_res_i.jsonl")
sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)
PYEOF
cd /app/work && python interactive64.py
